title: Teeth
examples: What are the different types of teeth?
Why are my baby teeth different from my adult teeth?
What protects my teeth from getting cavities?

explain.say: Today we are learning about your teeth. Say teeth help you chew your food.
Now look! Here it is in 3D: the layers of a tooth. Can you see the enamel and the dentine? Tap any part, and I will tell you about it.
The front teeth are called incisors. They are good for cutting food.
Next are the canines. These teeth are strong and pointy. They help you tear food.
The back teeth are called molars. They have big flat surfaces. They grind food well.
When you are little, you have milk teeth. These are your first set of teeth.
A hard white layer called enamel covers your teeth. This keeps them strong.

faq.q: Why do I have different types of teeth?
faq.a: Your teeth have different jobs to do. Incisors cut, canines tear, and molars grind food.
asks: What is the job of each tooth?
Why are there so many different teeth?

faq.q: Are my baby teeth the same as my adult teeth?
faq.a: No, they are different. Milk teeth are temporary until your adult teeth grow in later.
asks: Will my baby teeth fall out?
When do I get grown-up teeth?

faq.q: What is enamel and why is it important?
faq.a: Enamel is a very hard outer coating on your teeth. It helps protect the softer parts underneath.
asks: What is the hard covering on my teeth?

faq.q: Do I need to brush my teeth twice a day?
faq.a: Yes, brushing twice a day keeps your teeth clean. It helps stop little holes called cavities.

faq.q: Can I eat candy all the time?
faq.a: Eating lots of sugary things can make your teeth weak. Eating healthy foods helps keep your enamel strong.
asks: Are sweets bad for my teeth?
What foods are best for teeth?

facts: Incisors are used for cutting food at the front.
Molars are the large back teeth used for grinding.
Milk teeth are temporary teeth that fall out.
Enamel is the hard outer layer protecting the tooth.

quiz.say: Which teeth are best for tearing meat?
quiz.why: Canines are pointy and strong, making them perfect for tearing food.

wrong.0: Each tooth has a specific job it does best.
wrong.2: Incisors are best for cutting, not tearing.
wrong.3: Molars are flat and designed for grinding food.

quiz.say: What is the main job of molars?
quiz.why: Molars have big flat tops that help you grind food into a paste.

wrong.1: Cutting is the job of the front incisors.
wrong.2: Tearing is the job of the strong canines.
wrong.3: Chewing is the general action, but grinding is the specific action of molars.

quiz.say: If you are brushing your teeth, what are you cleaning?
quiz.why: Brushing cleans the hard outer layer, which is called enamel.

wrong.0: While you clean your gums, enamel is the main surface being cleaned.
wrong.1: The tongue needs cleaning, but enamel is the tooth surface we focus on here.
wrong.2: Food bits are what you are removing, not what you are cleaning.
